checks.what: Four independent audits read all 1321 cards against the MicrosoftDocs repositories they quote (checked word for word by the card checker) and the Microsoft Learn units they are written from
checks.result: About 130 scenario cards explained the options under the wrong letters after the right answer was moved; all were re-lettered, and the checker now catches this. Among the rest, one card had two right answers and one contradicted its source; 5 unsupported claims, 8 unclear cards and 13 minor issues were also fixed.
